PDF Interactive Visualization of Unstructured Grids Using Hierarchical 3D ...
Our approach to interactive volume rendering of unstructured grids involves an adaptive voxelization component, which occurs as a preprocess, and a volume level-of-detail component, which renders the voxel octree produced by the preprocess to provide visualization at interactive frame rates (see Figure 2).
